scripts.git: git add . && git commit -a && git push origin frontend
scripts.tracks: psql -U schulbert -h schulbert -d schulbert -c 'copy (select composers, album, title, artists, playlist_id, track_number from rich_tracks order by playlist_id, track_number) to stdout with (format csv, header true, encoding utf8)' > src/lib/assets/tracks.csv
scripts.postbuild: rsync -avz --delete --chmod=D775,F664 build/ schulbert:/www/data/schulbert/ && npm run git
